answer: Proof of Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where identity is tethered to capital rather than ephemeral digital signatures. In this model, an agent must bond assets at a specific network vertex to participate in consensus. Any attempt to fabricate a legion of identities becomes a costly fable, as the attacker must secure proportional stake for each fake account. This economic haven prevents flooding by ensuring that the cost of participation scales linearly with the network influence an adversary seeks.
